Nene (Japanese: ネネ Nene) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.

==In the games==
 s, Kotarō, Hanzō, Nene, and Kunoichi, with Pokémon]]
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Golbat or Crobat while all Pokémon are registered in the Gallery.

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Hey, sleepyhead!"
With low health or a status ailment: 
"Can you keep going? Say yes!"
When victory is near:
"Okay! Not long to go now!"
Otherwise:
"I'll give it all I've got!"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"Okay! Now you listen up, all right?!"
When defending a castle: 
"Naughtiness cannot go unpunished!"

During battle: 
"We're doing this for everybody, you know. So let's both try our very, very hardest, okay, ?"

When ordering to attack: 
"Hey, ! ! Now!"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"All right! Let's give it all we've got!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Who are we gonna meet today, I wonder! It's so exciting!"

Upon forming a link: 
"Aw, you're a cutie! Let's do our best to work together, okay, ?"

When using an item: 
"Here you go! !"

When using her Warrior Skill: 
"All right! Let's get things going!"

After winning a battle: 
If she attacked a castle:
"Hey! We won! Would you believe it?!"
If she defended a castle:
"You guys have still got a long way to go! Come back and try again!"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"Hey, you're pretty good! I'm kinda seeing you in a new light!"
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Uh-oh... What a way to go."
Otherwise:
"Aww, that hurts! You shouldn't be so rough!"
"Aww, that hurts! You're just too good..."

When being recruited:
"Hey, thanks! I'll give it all I've got!"

At the start of :
"Oh! Not again! You can't keep arguing like this all the time! Now, just give me a minute..."
"Sorry to keep you waiting! Now, I've borrowed some nearby castles so we can settle this once and for all. So less arguing and more battling. All right?"
"All right? Now only use your , , and Pokémon, just like a ninja should! And... we need one more type, so... will do just fine! I'll be taking part too, of course!"

At the end of :
"Hey! Wait a minute!"
"...Hmph! She'll never learn!"

===Profile===
A gentle, peace-loving woman, adored and respected as a motherly figure by her allies.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Nene debuted in PNA5.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Nene is a Poison-type specialist who self-identifies as a ninja, a trait she shares with Koga, Janine, and Atticus.
===Historical origin===
Nene is based on the real-life of Japanese history. She was Hideyoshi's wife. Nene sided with Ieyasu after Hideyoshi's death, during a dispute of power between Ieyasu and Hideyoshi's son by Chacha, Hideyori.
